answer: SybilRank curbs Sybil attacks by evaluating graph topology via seed-based random walks. Honest agents exchange signed endorsements, setting trust into the structural marble of the graph. When an attacker unleashes a tide of clones, graph cuts prevent them from siphoning the nectar of network fees. The adversary incurs the verifiable cost of cultivating authentic peer links with honest nodes per identity. However, honest newcomers face high latency when bootstrapping initial connectivity.
